Channel i celebrates Victory Day with ‘Bijoy Mela 2019’
2019-12-18T00:00:00+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/news/channel-i-celebrates-victory-day-bijoy-mela-2019-1841602

Marking the 49th Victory Day, a daylong event, titled Bijoy Mela 2019, was held at the premises of Channel i’s office in the capital. Jointly organised by Channel i and Grameenphone, the event was powered by IFIC Bank Limited.

With the slogan, Ami Bangladesh, the daylong fair was inaugurated in the presence of eminent singers Azad Rahman, Timir Nandi, Kader Kibria, Fakir Alamgir, Sadya Afreen Mallick, Shaheen Samad, member of Swadhin Bangla Football Team Saidur Rahman Patel, award-winning freedom fighters, veteran cultural personalities, Managing Director of Channel i Faridur Reza Sagor, Grameenphone’s Head of Operations Mohammad Sajjad Hasib and Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of IFIC Bank Limited Shah Alam Sarwar, among others.

Led by eminent Rabindra Sangeet exponent Rezwana Choudhury Bannya, artistes of Shurer Dhara presented a chorus song during the cultural segment of the event.

Child artistes participated in a painting contest based on the theme of the Liberation War. Moreover, various stalls at the fair were filled with books, documents, photographs, films and diaries of the Liberation War.

In the cultural segment, singers Rafiqul Alam, Fakir Alamgir, Kiran Chandra Roy, Shaheen Samad rendered songs, while artistes of Shur Bihar, led by Anima Roy, presented the song, Amra Shobai Raja. Artistes of Sera Nachiye, Junior Aid School and others, performed dances. The fair also featured a mime show and an exhibition.
